entities.name: The Domains
entities.description: A vaguely defined geographical region on Dominaria including the continent of Aerona and the archipelago to its east, home to many of Dominaria's most famous cultures.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the Domains lie.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: A continent, by far the largest landmass of the Domains.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: A land a few thousand miles east of the Domains across the Western Sea.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: One of the famous cultures of the Domains; Avenant is considered part of it and it colonized the Spice Isles.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: A culture of the Domains that conquered Askaranton.

entities.name: Island Wars
entities.description: A series of campaigns in which the Domains took part before the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion before which the Domains were part of the Island Wars.

entities.name: Askaranton
entities.description: A place conquered by Keld.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: An island of murky swamps in the Burning Isles; its city was destroyed ages ago by Nevinyrral.

entities.name: Nevinyrral
entities.description: The figure who destroyed the City of Urborg ages ago.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: The group whose base of operations is the Stronghold in Urborg.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: The being who transplanted a piece of Yavimaya's forest onto Urborg.

entities.name: Glenar
entities.description: The home of the Black Elves, where Red Donald fought off the elves and took control of a dragon whelp.

entities.name: Red Donald
entities.description: A figure who fought off the Black Elves at Glenar and took control of a dragon whelp.

entities.name: Oneah
entities.description: An island that once hosted a nation of the same name, famous for its scholars and martial artists.

entities.name: Orvada
entities.description: An empire covering an archipelago in the far eastern part of the Domains.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: An academy with campuses at Orvada City and Tolaria West.

entities.name: Vodalia
entities.description: The largest empire on the plane, a merfolk realm in the Voda Sea.

entities.name: Dwen
entities.description: A sorceress who hailed from White Island.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: A being who once slept on Mors Ridge.

events.summary: Before the Phyrexian Invasion, the Domains are part of the Island Wars.
events.quote: Some time before the Phyrexian Invasion, the Domains were part of a series of campaigns known as the Island Wars.
